content.text: A focus defines the general development objective of a character . If the Way of Life DLC is active, adults can choose a long-term effort among ten focuses (two for each attribute ).
By choosing a focus, a ruler:

items.text: Gets an immediate boost to the corresponding attribute ;
Unlocks related events , diplomatic actions or decisions ;
May eventually receive a lifestyle trait ;
Gets additional random events to improve the corresponding attribute if it is below 8 .

content.text: All playable characters can have a focus, if adult (16+ years-old) and not Incapable . Imprisoned characters can only choose Seduction, Scholarship, or Theology. Other restrictions are noted below.

After five years, it is possible to switch to another focus. This can be useful once the player has exhausted the main benefits of a focus, or if they want to collect positive traits and character modifiers from multiple focuses.
AI characters choose their focus based on traits and government type, instead of needs. They rarely change focus after selecting one.

content.text: You can only have 1 lifestyle trait, and personality traits often disappear once you have more than 6. Character modifiers, in contrast, can be collected in large numbers.
Many focuses feature a level up mechanic, in which you first gain character modifiers, and then have the opportunity to gain a lifestyle trait.

content.text: Focuses are a fairly easy way to gain positive traits and lose negative or less desirable ones:

items.text: Lose Arbitrary and gain Diligent , Ambitious and Just from Rulership
Gain Greedy from Business
Lose Chaste and gain Lustful from Seduction
Lose Honest and gain Deceitful from Intrigue
Gain Diligent or +1 health and lose Stressed and Depressed from Hunting
Gain Brawny and Brave from War
Lose Stressed and Depressed from Carousing
Gain Diligent , Brave , Cynical , Zealous or Paranoid from Scholarship
Gain Pilgrim from Theology

content.text: However, some focuses can also cause characters to gain negative traits; remember that gaining a trait which is "opposite" of one which you currently have will remove the current trait as well.

items.text: Master seducer or Master seductress , if you want a very large family. Compared to the level-2 character modifier, it gives +20 sex appeal and a special bedding option.
Master schemer , if spying is crucial to your strategy. Compared to the level-2 character modifier, it makes spying significantly faster.
Administrator , if your stewardship is 8 or higher, and you want the +10 vassal opinion
If Christian and aiming for sainthood , Impaler or Hedonist will disqualify your character!

sections.heading: Consider Business before getting a lifestyle trait

content.text: The Business focus tower and maze events give great character modifiers, but can only fire if you do not have a lifestyle trait. Note that these event chains can get very expensive if your income is high.

items.text: Administrator stacks with Organizer .
Architect stacks with Siege leader .
Game master stacks with Narrow flank leader .
Most combat specializations go well with Strategist (+20% defense) or Hunter (+20% pursuit).

sections.heading: Change focus depending on your needs

items.text: Troops :

children.text: Seduction helps form NAPs, while Carousing helps turn NAPs into alliances.

items.text: Cash :

children.text: Business lets you invest in potentially lucrative opportunities.
War gets you loot if you can raid.

items.text: Vassal opinion :

children.text: Rulership (+20 from Just , Diligent , respected ruler)
Scholarship (+10 from Brave , Diligent , and possibly more)
Theology (+5 from Pilgrim for Christians; if Catholic, +20 church opinion can influence clergy to provide liege taxes and levies).
Even Intrigue helps, by giving +3 realm opinion per rank of prisoner released for 30 months, or by letting you replace your vassals.

sections.heading: Use a sequence of focuses to improve your health

items.text: Seduction to improve health in many ways

children.text: Establish affairs with kind/diligent characters: if you are not getting along with your wife, lovers can invite you to a getaway. This gives you +1 health for 1 year, and perhaps more importantly, can remove stressed/depressed. The event will trigger more often if you have many lovers, if your lovers are kind , and if your lovers are diligent .
: Establish affairs with old/dying characters: can find a Lover's Memento (+0.5 health).
Establish rivalries with jealous husbands, if you plan to duel while using the War focus
Establish a large family, so your Court Physician can more easily gain the Renowned Physician trait and the "received professional praise" opinion modifier

items.text: War or Hunting for chance of Brawny trait ; Hunting can help lose Frail / Weak

children.text: More chances if you duel, at the risk of Wounded or Maimed
Best in or near the Byzantine empire, where there are many blind characters: they are unlikely to win duels.

items.text: Scholarship and/or Rulership risks Stressed (additional risk for Depressed for Rulership), but can allow you to pick up Diligent and other great traits.
Carousing if you still need to de-stress yourself (or your relatives)
Hunting at old age (+1 health while focus is active, +1 health for dog's lifespan, +1 health permanently for training dog while diligent)

sections.heading: Avoid peacetime focuses when war is likely

content.text: The following focuses are more useful when at peace:

items.text: Carousing focus: "Invite to Carousing" requires peace.
Theology focus: "Go on a Pilgrimage" (Christian/Dharmic) requires peace.
Hunting focus: "Hold a Grand Hunt" requires peace. The demesne levy boost is useful before war, but less so during war.
War focus: "Challenge to Duel" requires peace.

content.text: Furthermore, some focuses are less useful if you plan to lead troops:

items.text: Business focus: most events won't fire while leading troops
Seduction focus: targeted seduction tombola is skipped if leading troops
War focus: training events (MTTH) won't fire while leading troops
Family focus: events to improve relations won't fire while leading troops

content.text: Consider not only whether you plan to initiate a war, but also whether you are likely to be pulled into one:

items.text: Your factions are likely to rebel
Your provinces are likely to revolt , especially with dangerous religious or liberation revolts
Your allies are subject to faction rebellion
Your allies are likely to go to war and request help . They will request help until combined strength is 1.5 times the enemy's.
